units.title: Maximize a cyclic product under a cube-root sum
units.statement: For positive a,b,c,d whose cube roots sum to 4s, the maximum of abcd(a+b)(b+c)(c+d)(d+a) is 4 to the 14th times s to the 24th divided by 5 to the 10th. Concavity in opposite cube roots forces them equal; the remaining product is u^6(8-6u)^4 times s^24 with u in (0,1].
steps: Use concavity of log[x(x cubed+t)] to equalize opposite variables
Let u be the product of the two remaining normalized values and optimize on (0,1]
